hints.badge-mixin: `ods-badge()` now draws a 1px solid border (coloured by `ods-badge-color()`, `currentColor` without it) and a full radius: to keep the v19 look, add `border: 0` and `--ods-badge-border-radius: var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-control)` after the include.
hints.declaration: a v19 theme declaration: a v20 theme declares the palette (`--ods-palette-*`) and, where a role needs its own value, the semantic token (`--ods-semantic-*`).
hints.disabled: disabled is an opacity in v20, not a colour: remove this colour. To dim like ODS, set `opacity: var(--ods-semantic-opacity-disabled)` on `:disabled` / `[data-disabled]`; for a grey, write your own colour there.
hints.disabled-scss: disabled is an opacity in v20, not a colour: to look disabled like ODS, replace these colours with `@include ods-is-disabled()` (or `opacity: var(--ods-semantic-opacity-disabled)`); to keep a grey, write your own colour.
hints.drawer-max-size: removed: use `$drawer-max-width` or `$drawer-max-height`, or write its v19 value, calc(100% - 48px).
hints.is-disabled-mixin: `ods-is-disabled()` now dims with `opacity: var(--ods-semantic-opacity-disabled)` instead of painting the v19 disabled grey: anything painted on this element is dimmed too. To keep a grey, set the colours here yourself.
hints.message-close: removed: the close button of a Message keeps its neutral look on every status and emphasis in v20, so an override has no effect and a read resolves to nothing. Remove it, or style the close button inside `[data-ods="message"]` yourself.
hints.button-status-removed: removed: the `information`, `success` and `warning` Buttons are gone in v20 (use `status="neutral"`, or a Message for a status), so an override of it paints nothing: delete it.
hints.link-hover: no v20 theme role: the Link hover colour is `--ods-link-text-color-hover`, set it on `[data-ods="link"]`. Its default is the rest colour, and the thicker underline is the hover signal in v20.
hints.modal-color-mixin: removed: the header background it painted belongs to a `color` the Modal no longer renders. Delete this include.
hints.modal-header: removed: the Modal header has no status colour in v20, so an override has no effect and a read resolves to nothing. Remove it, or style the header inside `[data-ods="modal-content"]` yourself.
hints.modal-margin: removed: use `$ods-modal-margin-horizontal` or `$ods-modal-margin-vertical`, or write its v19 value, 16px.
hints.switch: removed with the Switch component: replace the Switch (Tabs with `variant="switch"`, Button Group or Radio Group, see the Switch section of the migration guide) and style the replacement through its own custom properties.
hints.tab-selected: removed: a selected Tab paints the theme roles `--ods-semantic-color-border-selected-solid` (border), `--ods-semantic-color-surface-selected` (background) and `--ods-semantic-color-content-on-selected` (text) in v20. Override those inside `[data-ods="tab"][aria-selected="true"]` instead.
hints.toggle-border: removed: the Toggle border reads `--ods-semantic-color-border-control` in v20. Override that inside `[data-ods="toggle-control"]` instead.
hints.unread-removed: removed: it held the rest value and nothing read it, so an override of it never did anything. Delete it.
hints.no-equivalent: no v20 token for this value: write the value.
hints.number-to-var: a CSS var() in v20, not a Sass number: Sass arithmetic on it fails or emits a value the browser drops. Wrap it in calc().
hints.palette-changed: this palette variable keeps its name in v20 with another colour, and no v20 stop holds the v19 one: write the value, or pick a `--ods-semantic-color-*` role.
hints.palette-removed: removed, and no v20 palette stop holds this colour: write the value, or pick a `--ods-semantic-color-*` role.
hints.radius-xs: removed, v20 has no radius below `--ods-semantic-size-radius-control` (4px): write its v19 value, 2px, or use the closest `--ods-semantic-size-radius-*`.
hints.role: v20 names colours by what they paint: pick the one for this place.
hints.shared: in the v20 default theme, this palette step also feeds
hints.tile: removed, and never read even in v19 (`Tile` renders a `Card`): this override did nothing. Remove it; overriding the Card token instead changes the rendering.
hints.toggle-hover: removed: the unchecked `Toggle` no longer changes its background on hover, so an override has no effect and a read resolves to nothing. Remove it, or style `[data-ods="toggle-control"]:hover` yourself.
hints.unknown: ODS v19 never declared this name: it gives its fallback value (or nothing), in v19 as in v20. Nothing to do for the migration.
hints.unread: ODS v20 still declares this token but no longer reads it: an override of it has no effect.
hints.z-rerank: the ODS overlays get new z-index values in v20 (v19: dropdowns 99, modal 100, drawer 101; v20: sticky 100, dropdown 200, drawer 300, modal 400), so a value computed from this token, kept in a variable, or overriding it may now land under a drawer or a modal: check what it must sit above, and set its value by hand.

$ods-input-actions-padding-right.note: keeps its name and goes from 4px to 2px in v20 (`--ods-semantic-size-space-inset-block-compact`), like the action buttons of ODS fields. To keep 4px, write `calc(var(--ods-semantic-size-space-inset-inline) / 2)`.

$ods-overlay-base-z-index.note: keeps its name and its layer, 99 in v19 and `--ods-semantic-z-index-dropdown` (200) in v20: a value you compute from it (`+ 1`) or that must clear another overlay may now land elsewhere, check it (a drawer now sits under a modal).

$ods-overlay-drawer-z-index.note: keeps its name and its layer, 101 in v19 and `--ods-semantic-z-index-drawer` (300) in v20: a value you compute from it (`+ 1`) or that must clear another overlay may now land elsewhere, check it (a drawer now sits under a modal).

$ods-overlay-modal-z-index.note: keeps its name and its layer, 100 in v19 and `--ods-semantic-z-index-modal` (400) in v20: a value you compute from it (`+ 1`) or that must clear another overlay may now land elsewhere, check it (a drawer now sits under a modal).

$ods-badge-border-radius.note: keeps its name with another value in v20 (`var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-full)`). To keep the v19 size, write `calc(var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-container) / 2)`.

$ods-badge-padding-horizontal-sm.note: keeps its name with another value in v20 (`var(--ods-semantic-size-space-inset-inline)`). To keep the v19 size, write `calc(var(--ods-semantic-size-space-inset-inline) / 2)`.

$ods-badge-padding-horizontal-md.note: keeps its name with another value in v20 (`var(--ods-semantic-size-space-inset-inline)`). To keep the v19 size, write `calc(var(--ods-semantic-size-space-inset-inline) / 2)`.

$ods-badge-padding-horizontal-lg.note: keeps its name with another value in v20 (`calc(var(--ods-semantic-size-space-inset-inline) * 1.5)`). To keep the v19 size, write `calc(var(--ods-semantic-size-space-inset-inline) * 0.75)`.

$ods-button-border-radius-xs.note: keeps its name with another value in v20 (`var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-control)`). To keep the v19 size, write `calc(var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-container) / 4)`.

$ods-button-border-radius-sm.note: keeps its name with another value in v20 (`var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-control)`). To keep the v19 size, write `calc(var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-container) / 2)`.

$ods-button-border-radius-md.note: keeps its name with another value in v20 (`var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-control)`). To keep the v19 size, write `var(--ods-semantic-size-radius-container)`.

--ods-theme-overlay-z-index.detail: this token is 99 in v19; its v20 layer, `--ods-semantic-z-index-dropdown`, is 200
